crossRefs.note: Again he departed from the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and came to the sea of Galilee, through the middle of the region…
Great multitudes from Galilee, Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea and from beyond the Jordan followed him.

people.name: Decapolis
people.line: A group of ten Hellenistic cities in ancient Palestine.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: He went his way, and began to proclaim in Decapolis how Jesus had done great things for him, and everyone marveled.
translations.bsb: So the man went away and began to proclaim throughout the Decapolis how much Jesus had done for him. And everyone was amazed.
translations.kjv: And he departed, and began to publish in Decapolis how great things Jesus had done for him: and all men did marvel.
translations.asv: And he went his way, and began to publish in Decapolis how great things Jesus had done for him: and all men marvelled.
